text_block_list.text:
One day, while shopping with Neo 
Universe...

text_block_list.name: Street Vendor
text_block_list.text:
Long time no see, you two. I happen to 
have acquired some fine goods just now... 
Fufufufu. Please, right this way.
choice_data_list:
Huh... You're the street vendor from "that 
time"...!?

text_block_list.text:
"Memories of being called out to by a 
street vendor last year resurface. That 
was where the bizarre adventure of 
catching a rabbit that escaped from the 
moon began..."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Eclipse" detected... Neo Universe wants 
to chase it.
choice_data_list: Understood... Let's go check it out.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Did I lose it? The signal too...
choice_data_list: Yeah... Huh?
Yeah... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Call. Neo Universe is currently scanning 
for the "Singularity" male. Was there any 
"BAO" in the vicinity?

text_block_list.name: Grandma
text_block_list.text: "Nah. Didn't see anyone suspicious~."
choice_data_list:
Thank you for the information... Wait, 
whaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Access" recognized? It's not "inflation," 
is it...?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
“I deny the ‘thought-form’ theory. It's a 
‘neuron encode.’”
choice_data_list:
Is this the "special treat" the street 
vendor was talking about?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"ART"... It's "amazing"! Neo Universe 
wants to say "hello." "A to Z," with 
Trainer too...!

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
—Yes, thank you very much! Natto pasta, 
soy parfait, and the drink bar. That 
completes your order, correct? Please wait 
just a moment.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Order achieved "Type I movement." 
"Amazing"... should I apply "EDFA"...!
choice_data_list: (She looks so happy... I'm glad.)
(She looks so happy... I'm glad.)

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, they're all such difficult books... 
Am I... not cut out to be an astronaut...?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Hey... That book is our "propellant." 
Learning about the cosmic "monoliths" 
through "Hubble" makes it so easy to 
understand.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... You're right, that's super easy to 
get! Thanks, big sis! You really know a 
lot about space!
choice_data_list: Haha, I'm glad they liked it.
Haha, I'm glad they liked it.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Yeah... "METI".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Big Bang." It really is forming a 
"filament"...
choice_data_list: Good for you, Neo Universe!
Good for you, Universe!

text_block_list.name: Street Vendor
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. It seems to have struck your 
fancy. This world feels quite comfortable, 
doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"I couldn't detect your 'signal.' ...Just 
who are you?"
choice_data_list:
Besides, what do you mean by "this 
world"...?

text_block_list.name: Street Vendor
text_block_list.text:
A multidimensional universe generated by a 
supernova. Using the gravitational pull of 
the full moon to connect the gate, I have 
guided you to a parallel area.

text_block_list.name: Street Vendor
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, this world has entered a "stable 
phase" as well. You may close the gate and 
anchor it, you know?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe is a "reentry module." This 
isn't my "place."
choice_data_list: Huh, is that okay...?
Huh, are you sure...?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. The multidimensional cosmic realm 
might actually be the "habitable zone." 
There are times when "9.807" feels 
suffocating—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: —Even so.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe doesn't want to destroy what 
she and her Trainer have built together.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
That's why... returning to the 
"Satellite"...!
choice_data_list: Ah... Words just fail me—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative... You... the "hub"... are 
"connecting"... Neo Universe—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: If it's with you... Affirmative.

"Before I knew it, the white light and the 
street vendor had vanished. I must have 
returned to my original world, but—"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Today is our... "Roche limit."
choice_data_list: Yeah, and my stomach is totally empty.
Yeah, I'm starving too.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Let's "ABT" the "energy." Universe will 
order for Trainer too.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I won't give any more room for an 
'abduction.' Let's cross 'Vallis 
Menelaus.'
choice_data_list:
Still, you can count on me when you're in 
trouble.

Still, you can count on me when you're in 
trouble.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Yeah...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Selecting "Terra," and "Muteph." I'm 
"glad"... to be back with you.

text_block_list.name: Woman in a Trench Coat
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, you two. Care to see the hidden 
dark side of the moon?
choice_data_list:
Ahaha, an invitation to another mysterious 
experience, huh?

Ahaha, another invitation to something 
bizarre, I take it?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
F-Fufufu... There's no "vibration-free" 
for Neo Universe and the others.

I'm sure there will be plenty of strange 
and unexpected events ahead. But together 
with Neo Universe—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Docking" with adventure once more. "Fun" 
is about to "STIN".
choice_data_list: Alright, let's go together!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
To the next "dimension." Toward "our" 
future...!
